The Master Reward acts as a gate for you: The Master Reward acts as a gate for your Avatar Scaling channel-point rewards. When enabled, all child scale rewards stay hidden or deleted on Twitch until a viewer redeems the master reward to unlock them for a set duration.
This keeps your Twitch reward panel clea: This keeps your Twitch reward panel clean - you don't need every scale reward visible all the time. Viewers redeem the master reward once, then pick which height they want from the unlocked child rewards.
Supporter Growth rules are not affected: Supporter Growth rules are not affected - they listen to bits and subs directly and do not need the master reward to fire.

Wardrobe mode lets you create named outf: Wardrobe mode lets you create named outfits that capture snapshots of avatar parameters. When redeemed, the outfit applies its parameters and restores the original values after the active time ends.
Let viewers type an outfit name in one s: Let viewers type an outfit name in one shared reward to choose which Wardrobe outfit fires.

Wardrobe lets you create named outfits t: Wardrobe lets you create named outfits that capture snapshots of avatar parameters. When redeemed, the outfit applies its parameters and restores the original values after the active time ends.
Wardrobe needs 70 seconds to safely read: Wardrobe needs 70 seconds to safely read VRChat avatar data before it restores an outfit. Shorter active times will be extended during runtime.
Active times below 70 seconds can restor: Active times below 70 seconds can restore before VRChat finishes writing outfit changes, so Crystal Relay will extend this outfit to 70 seconds when it runs.
VRChat restart will use the last real in: VRChat restart will use the last real instance found in the local VRChat log because the VRChat API did not report a rejoinable instance.
When checked, the VRChat restart button: When checked, the VRChat restart button launches VRChat with --no-vr.
